nodes.description: Sustained oral zinc replacement is the central treatment. The 2025 literature review separately reports improvement in 29 of 30 supplemented patients with SLC39A4 mutations, including one nonresponder who died. Among those treated, 12 received 1-3 mg/kg/day and six received more than 3 mg/kg/day; the remaining doses were not weight-adjusted or not recorded. These heterogeneous case reports do not establish an optimal dose. Zinc and copper monitoring accompany long-term replacement.
